description: Storefront page URLs of variants, ready to hand to a CMS, PIM or feed. Each variant carries a `relative_link_url` from the API — it already reflects the store's path settings and selects the variant (`?variant=`) — and this tool joins it with the store's b2c_url, so no URL rules have to be maintained on the integration side. One call instead of list_variants + get_store. Same filters as list_variants; archived variants are excluded by the API. The response carries a machine-readable coverage envelope (coverage, received, total_count, pages_read); coverage:"partial" MUST be reflected in the user-facing answer and forbids claiming the listing is complete.

all.description: Fetch all pages via auto-pagination, up to 500 items; ignores page/per_page.

name.description: Case-insensitive partial search by name, SKU, barcode or KIT ID.

per_page.description: Items per page, 1-100 (default 25). Values outside the range are clamped.

name: list_variant_links
title: List variant storefront links
